items.problem: The mandatory bootstrap omitted external project inputs represented by Include plus Link metadata, so its supposedly complete mapping contained only 4 of 19 migration inputs.
items.evidence: TextSegmentation.csproj lines 93-169 link shared App, MainPage, scenario XAML, styles, code, and assets; session-log.txt lines 122-149 reports only 4 copied files.
items.skill_search: Searched Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 for Link, Compile Include, Page Include, linked, and SharedContent; no linked-item handling existed.
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 used only a recursive directory crawl rooted at Source and never evaluated external project items.
items.proposed_fix: Extend Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 to resolve common MSBuild properties, copy external items to their Link targets, and include them in mapping/triage.
items.generalizes: Legacy UWP projects commonly share XAML, code, and assets through linked project items outside the project folder.

items.problem: The skill required winapp build although the installed WinApp CLI has no build command.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 2915-2973: the command was rejected and the CLI command list contained run but not build.
items.skill_search: Searched SKILL.md and MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md for winapp build and dotnet build; SKILL.md prescribed winapp build in Step 3 and after validation.
items.root_cause: The skill conflated WinApp launch/package commands with native .NET compilation.
items.proposed_fix: Use dotnet build consistently and retain Test-AppLaunch.ps1 for packaged launch.
items.generalizes: Every C# WinUI migration must compile, and the standalone WinApp CLI command surface does not provide build.

items.problem: Startup diagnostics classified a managed 0x8001010E failure as generic 0xe0434352 and the docs categorically dismissed the generated entry point, causing repeated irrelevant edits.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3337-3346 reports generic managed-exception advice; lines 3716-3728 show COMException 0x8001010E with only Program.Main and Application.Start; turns 24-33 changed navigation and UseRidGraph without effect.
items.skill_search: Searched Test-AppLaunch.ps1 and MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md for 0xe0434352, 0x8001010E, STAThread, and Program.Main.
items.wrong_text_if_any: Do not assume the entry point is the problem... [STAThread] is required, not a bug.
items.root_cause: Test-AppLaunch selected hints from event 1000's CLR wrapper instead of event 1026's HRESULT, while prose lacked an entry-point-only/toolchain branch.
items.proposed_fix: Prefer the managed HRESULT and direct entry-point-only stacks to an untouched-scaffold comparison and toolchain alignment before migrated-code changes.
items.generalizes: Managed WinUI startup crashes routinely use outer code 0xe0434352; the inner HRESULT and first application frame are required to distinguish migration defects from scaffold/runtime incompatibility.
